researchQuestion: Can the final governed EVLLM reduce user-visible operations while preserving deterministic decision accuracy, structured record coverage, citation traceability, and normalized missing/conflict detection?

analysis.pairedUnit: case after averaging five governed repetitions
analysis.multipleComparisons: Holm correction within each metric family
analysis.zeroFailureRule: Report numerator, denominator, and 95% upper confidence bound.

interpretationBoundary: Machine-measured interface behavior only; no subjective usability claim. Route-comparison cases use the implemented six-component Contextual Battery Route Sustainability Assessment and never an overall sustainability score.
designation: Only results bound to this freeze, the recorded source commit, and the exact corpus hashes belong to the final synthesis evidence set.
